messages.subject: second evals due this week
messages.body_plain:
Dear mentors,

The second GSOC evaluations are due on July 28, 2017 at 11:59 (EDT) -- less than four days from now.

This is a mandatory part of GSOC and the R project will be penalized if you don't fill out an evaluation for your student.

Please complete your evaluations as soon as possible on https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/dashboard/

Thanks in advance!
